        main_rite = rite:lyd_rite_kongmen

        NOT = { any_faith_rite = { count >= 36 } }

    exists = var:lyd_r4_receiving_faith
    var:lyd_r4_receiving_faith = {
        religion = religion:confucianism_religion main_rite = rite:lyd_rite_jingshu
        NOT = { exists = religious_head } NOT = { exists = religious_head_title }
        any_faith_rite = { count = 1 }
        NOT = { any_faith_rite = { count >= 2 } }
    }
    rite:lyd_rite_jingshu = { faith = root.var:lyd_r4_receiving_faith }
    var:lyd_r4_source_rep = {
        is_ai = yes lyd_c2_elector_trigger = yes
        has_character_flag = lyd_r4_created_source_rep
        is_courtier_of = root
        rite = rite:lyd_rite_zhuxi faith = root.var:lyd_r4_initial_source_faith
        NOT = { is_landed = yes }

    var:lyd_r4_jingshu_rep = {
        is_ai = yes lyd_c2_elector_trigger = yes
        has_character_flag = lyd_r4_created_jingshu_rep
